kind: real navigation failure through the production retry ladder

steps.name: space A loads a URL nothing listens on
the sixth failure stops monitoring, raises one card and requests one OS notification
steps.limitation: a refused local connection, not a provider outage

steps.name: a working load restores monitoring and clears the card without a new notification

alertBody: The page failed repeatedly and Bop stopped retrying, so nothing from this account can reach you. Open the space to start again; the saved session is kept.
